clips.title: The King of the Cycle Zombies Can't Explain This Bitcoin Move
clips.hook: The king of the four-year cycle zombies, Benjamin Cowen, was absolutely perplexed about how Bitcoin went above the May high.
clips.caption: Benjamin Cowen, the king of the four-year cycle zombies, was absolutely perplexed about how Bitcoin ($BTC) went above the May high. People are front-running the October bottom because they realize the bottom is IN. That's it. You just can't figure that out by looking at a chart. When I came to the conclusion there's no such thing as a four-year cycle, I felt illuminated.

clips.title: TAO to $3,000? That's Not the Ceiling
clips.hook: TAO going to 3000. Hell yeah, I totally agree.
clips.caption: $TAO to $3,000? Hell yeah, I totally agree. In the long run I think TAO can go a lot more than that. We've got some craziness going on, but we should be going into one hell of a fantastic economic expansion. Very, very soon.

clips.title: They Take a Long Time to Move. Then They Do a 350x.
clips.hook: They take a long time when they move.
clips.caption: We did the 58x on Velvet in June. I called it in July 2025, and it took 11 months. Called $LAB in October, DCA'd a little more in December when it went down, and then it did a 350x in May. Long term plays, not these crazy things.

clips.title: You Took a 10x. Then Everybody Called It a Scam.
clips.hook: The point is, you got to get in and make money and get out.
clips.caption: Some coins only pump to 3 million. Some pump to 3 billion. If something dumps at 6 million like Golden Kitty ($GOLDEN), you can't say it's a scam: people got in, made money and got out. You do a 10x in a couple of weeks, you're happy, you feel good about yourself. Then it dumps and everybody else says, man, it's a scam.
